title: Storyteller refresh scenarios
description: A file of kind refresh: a provider starts from one answer, then runs one refresh per step. Each step's response answers every request of its run.

key.description: The full key the runner reads, as STORYTELLER_KEY.

start.description: The answer to the startup read, and the flat keys the provider then has.

step.description: One refresh run: the platform answers with response, or does not answer within the provider's read timeout (timeout).

expect.description: refreshed: whether the run succeeded. keys: the complete flat keys after the run. notifications: the change notifications since the start, cumulative. ifNoneMatch: the tag the run's read sent, or null. error: the failure of the run, exactly when refreshed is false.

keys.description: The flat keys (target flat) with their raw text, compared by exact text.

response.description: An answer of the platform. A json body is sent as compact JSON with Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8, a text body with Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8; without either there is no body. The headers are sent as written.

json.description: Any JSON value; an ErrorResponse leaves a field out rather than writing null.

failure.description: status: the HTTP status the failure reports, null when no answer arrived or the failure is local. errorCode: the non-blank ErrorCode of the body, or null. transient: worth trying again later, so a provider falls back to its cache and keeps polling.
